scripts.title: Auto Guess 100%, Custom Accuracy, Auto Collect, Coins & More
scripts.features:
Made for Guess The Color.

Basically does the guessing for you and has an auto coin farm built in.

Features:
ALL TOGGABLE

🎯 Auto detects the character's color

⚡ Picks the answer automatically when the round starts

🚀 Auto submits the answer

📊 Accuracy settings: 100% / 98% / 95% / 90% / 80% + custom %

💰 Auto coin farm — teleports to coins and collects them automatically

📍 Saves your original position and brings you back when coin farm is turned off

👁️ Shows the current character + RGB color

🖥️ Draggable / minimizable UI
and a button so it dsoent do it automaticly just have a button guess and it guesses the procent you chose

🔑 No annoying key steps.
